scenarios.faultCategory: Reading pegged low (at or below 4 mA)
scenarios.faultDescription: Confirm polarity and that no wire is lifted or backed out.
scenarios.faultSource: Field Troubleshooting Template Pack.pdf p.9, Form 7 "Reading pegged low (at or below 4 mA)", step 3
scenarios.numbers: Healthy signal 60% = 13.6 mA (p.4 table). Past the fault: 0.0 mA (p.4: open circuit, lifted wire). EU values by the p.4 formula EU = LRV + ((I - 4) / 16) x (URV - LRV).
scenarios.constructed: Tag, service, which link is faulted, and the healthy process % are constructed for training.

scenarios.faultCategory: Reading pegged high (at or above 20 mA)
scenarios.faultDescription: For temperature, check for an open thermocouple or RTD lead.
scenarios.faultSource: Field Troubleshooting Template Pack.pdf p.9, Form 7 "Reading pegged high (at or above 20 mA)", step 6
scenarios.numbers: Healthy signal 50% = 12.0 mA (p.4 table). Past the fault: 21.0 mA (p.4: device failure alarm, NAMUR NE43 high; Form 7: upscale burnout). EU values by the p.4 formula EU = LRV + ((I - 4) / 16) x (URV - LRV).
scenarios.constructed: Tag, service, which link is faulted, and the healthy process % are constructed for training.

scenarios.faultDescription: Check for zero shift: has the device been overpressured, or the mounting changed?
scenarios.faultSource: Field Troubleshooting Template Pack.pdf p.9, Form 7 "Reading is wrong but stable", step 3
scenarios.numbers: Healthy signal 50% = 12.0 mA (p.4 table). Past the fault: zero-shifted to 60% = 13.6 mA (p.4 table). EU values by the p.4 formula EU = LRV + ((I - 4) / 16) x (URV - LRV).
scenarios.constructed: Tag, service, which link is faulted, and the healthy process % are constructed for training.

scenarios.faultDescription: Check controller scaling and raw counts before touching the field device.
scenarios.faultSource: Field Troubleshooting Template Pack.pdf p.9, Form 7 "Reading is wrong but stable", step 2
scenarios.numbers: Healthy signal 75% = 16.0 mA (p.4 table). Past the fault: the card reads 12.0 mA (50%, p.4 table). EU values by the p.4 formula EU = LRV + ((I - 4) / 16) x (URV - LRV).
scenarios.constructed: Tag, service, which link is faulted, and the healthy process % are constructed for training.

scenarios.faultCategory: Reading pegged low (at or below 4 mA)
scenarios.faultDescription: Compare to the actual process with an independent indication.
scenarios.faultSource: Field Troubleshooting Template Pack.pdf p.9, Form 7 "Reading pegged low (at or below 4 mA)", step 5
scenarios.numbers: Normal (what operations expect) 50% = 12.0 mA (p.4 table). Actual: the process really is at LRV, 4.0 mA (p.4: process truly at LRV). EU values by the p.4 formula EU = LRV + ((I - 4) / 16) x (URV - LRV).
scenarios.constructed: Tag, service, which link is faulted, and the healthy process % are constructed for training.
